result.instructions: Tools for Packeta, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Create a Packeta packet for order 1042 to branch 79, COD 1450 CZK, 2 kg."; "Where is packet 1234567890 right now, and when does it reach the pick-up point?"; "Show the full tracking history of packet 1234567890.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Packeta data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run packeta_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run packeta_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run packeta_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. packeta_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: packeta_validate_packet
tools.title: Validate a packet
tools.description: Check packet data against Packeta's rules without creating anything. Use it before packeta_create_packet. Packeta API: packetAttributesValid.

number.description: Your order number: unique, 1 to 36 letters or digits.

email.description: Recipient email. Give an email or a phone number.

phone.description: Recipient phone in international form, e.g. +420777123456.

addressId.description: Destination: a Packeta branch ID or an external carrier ID.

currency.description: ISO 4217 code of the COD and value, e.g. CZK.

cod.description: Cash on delivery amount in the packet currency.

value.description: Packet value for insurance, in the packet currency.

deliverOn.description: Scheduled delivery date, yyyy-mm-dd, within 14 days.

eshop.description: Sender indication, when the account has more than one sender.

note.description: Sender note, shown on the label where the carrier supports it. No double quote or semicolon.

carrierPickupPoint.description: Carrier pick-up point code, when the carrier needs one.

tools.name: packeta_packet_status
tools.title: Get packet status
tools.description: Get the current status of a packet: its state, whether it is returning to the sender, the last day it can be picked up, and its carrier. Packeta API: packetStatus.

packetId.description: Packet ID, digits only (returned by packeta_create_packet).

tools.name: packeta_packet_tracking
tools.title: Get packet tracking history
tools.description: Get the full tracking history of a packet, one record per status change. Packeta API: packetTracking.

packetId.description: Packet ID, digits only (returned by packeta_create_packet).

tools.name: packeta_packet_info
tools.title: Get packet info
tools.description: Get a packet's destination branch, verified invoice weight, and courier consignment details (courier, courier numbers, barcodes), when there is one. Packeta API: packetInfo.

packetId.description: Packet ID, digits only (returned by packeta_create_packet).

tools.name: packeta_shipment_packets
tools.title: List packets in a shipment
tools.description: List the packets inside a shipment, given its D-code or B-code shipment ID. Packeta API: shipmentPackets.

shipmentId.description: Shipment ID: a D-code or B-code, e.g. D-123456.

tools.name: packeta_return_routing
tools.title: Get return routing strings
tools.description: Get the two return routing strings of a sender, to print on return labels. They change with account settings, so fetch them each time. Packeta API: senderGetReturnRouting.

senderLabel.description: Sender label of the account (the eshop indication).

tools.name: packeta_create_packet
tools.title: Create a packet
tools.description: Create a packet in the customer's Packeta account and return its ID and barcode. This is a live action: the packet is registered at once and can be handed to a carrier. Run packeta_validate_packet first. Packeta API: createPacket.

number.description: Your order number: unique, 1 to 36 letters or digits.

email.description: Recipient email. Give an email or a phone number.

phone.description: Recipient phone in international form, e.g. +420777123456.

addressId.description: Destination: a Packeta branch ID or an external carrier ID.

currency.description: ISO 4217 code of the COD and value, e.g. CZK.

cod.description: Cash on delivery amount in the packet currency.

value.description: Packet value for insurance, in the packet currency.

deliverOn.description: Scheduled delivery date, yyyy-mm-dd, within 14 days.

eshop.description: Sender indication, when the account has more than one sender.

note.description: Sender note, shown on the label where the carrier supports it. No double quote or semicolon.

carrierPickupPoint.description: Carrier pick-up point code, when the carrier needs one.

tools.name: packeta_cancel_packet
tools.title: Cancel a packet
tools.description: Cancel a packet that has not been physically handed over yet. The cancellation cannot be undone. Packeta API: cancelPacket.

packetId.description: Packet ID, digits only (returned by packeta_create_packet).

prompts.name: getting_started
prompts.title: Get started with Packeta
prompts.description: What you can do with Packeta here, with example requests to try.

prompts.name: validate_a_packet_then_create_it
prompts.title: Validate a packet, then create it
prompts.description: Check the packet data against Packeta's rules first. Then create the packet and get its ID and barcode. A created packet is registered at once.

prompts.name: track_a_parcel_to_its_pick_up_point
prompts.title: Track a parcel to its pick-up point
prompts.description: Read the current status of a packet and its last pick-up day. Then read the full tracking history and the destination branch.

prompts.name: list_the_packets_of_a_shipment
prompts.title: List the packets of a shipment
prompts.description: Enter the D-code or B-code of a shipment to list its packets. Then read the courier numbers of one packet.

prompts.name: get_return_routing_for_return_labels
prompts.title: Get return routing for return labels
prompts.description: Fetch the two return routing strings of your sender account. Print them on return labels, because they can change with the account settings.

prompts.name: cancel_a_packet_before_handover
prompts.title: Cancel a packet before handover
prompts.description: Cancel a packet that has not been handed over yet. A cancellation cannot be undone.
